C1396.title: Silex Botnet Attack Damages IoT Devices with Default Credentials
C1396.summary: The Silex botnet exploited default credentials on IoT devices, permanently damaging or bricking a large number of them. What began as a prank led to real, widespread destruction, highlighting the severity of default credential risks.
